# Design Tokens Pro

> Digital guide for building scalable design systems with design tokens.
> For designers and developers. Author: Francesco Improta.
> Formats: online + printable PDF.

Design Tokens Pro covers taxonomy, naming conventions, token architecture,
themes/color modes, lifecycle management, and documentation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.designtokens.pro/): Guide overview, chapters, FAQ, pricing
- [Home (Markdown)](https://www.designtokens.pro/index.md): Same content as plain Markdown
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.designtokens.pro/privacy): Data handling and cookies
- [Privacy (Markdown)](https://www.designtokens.pro/privacy.md): Same content as plain Markdown
- [Compare](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare): How the guide differs from other design token resources
- [vs Subatomic](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare/subatomic): Written guide vs Brad Frost’s video course
- [vs Figma Variables](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare/figma-variables): Tool-agnostic guide vs Figma Variables
- [vs Style Dictionary](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare/style-dictionary): Naming guide vs the open-source transformer
- [vs Tokens Studio](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare/tokens-studio): Architecture guide vs the Figma plugin
- [vs DTCG spec](https://www.designtokens.pro/compare/dtcg-spec): Practical process vs the interchange format
